annotations.title: Who owns the answer in my category? (quick, under $1)

description: Use when the user asks which brands or websites AI assistants rely on for their category and a quick read is enough. Asks ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity two buyer questions live, once each, and returns the most-cited domains as counts of answers, whether the category is owned, led, contested or fragmented, and, if given, where your domain stands. Not the answers themselves. No stability check; buy a second run, or use run_answer_share, to see whether the leaders hold. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.74 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $1.06 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token). Fixed price per run, not per answer. Charged in full when at least half the answers cite sources and at least 3 of 4 platforms do; otherwise it refuses and nothing is charged. So a charged run can rest on as few as 4 of 8 answers; the result reports exactly how many (controls.measurement). A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/answer-share-quick.json
